purpose: Decide which existing results can be reused and which changed models require new calculations

rules.change: analysis definition such as contact cutoff or profile reference
rules.action: reanalyze saved trajectory into a separate analysis version
rules.limit: events between unsaved frames cannot be recovered by reanalysis

rules.action: extend TPR and continue verified checkpoint;preserve velocities/state
rules.reuse: existing trajectory is the preceding segment

rules.change: partial charges,LJ,bonded parameters or chemical connectivity
rules.action: new model/version/output directory;validate topology and starting geometry;minimize/reequilibrate under new Hamiltonian as appropriate
rules.reuse: old coordinates may seed the new model after checks;old statistics remain tied to old Hamiltonian

rules.change: coating morphology,chain length,graft/crosslink graph or protein conformer
rules.reuse: unaffected parameters and independent control results retain their original scope

rules.action: new mixture inventory and strict charge/clash/preprocessing checks;new EM/relaxation
rules.reuse: legacy neutralizing-ion pilots remain separate baselines

rules.action: new protocol version and equilibration;EM only if geometry/force changes warrant it
rules.reuse: do not combine ensemble statistics without an explicit valid method

preservation: No reset or overwrite of completed runs;record source coordinate/checkpoint and parameter hashes
current_decision: retain all existing pilots;new phosphate controls use projected charges in separate systems;azide102ps continues the unchanged accepted2ps model
